standoff_1.speaker: VOLKOV
standoff_1.text: Easy. I'm a clerk. I count crates.

standoff_2.speaker: BIRIBEL
standoff_2.text: Then count to three and walk with me.

standoff_3.speaker: VOLKOV
standoff_3.text: Read it before you hand it over!

routes.quiet: quiet_entry, alarm not raised: gameplay freezes, camera eases to frame both, 24 px letterbox, ~9 s. Commander K spots them afterwards (scripted alarm), Volkov runs out the bay door, VASILE VO_094 (m1.radio volkov_escaped).
routes.loud: no freeze: when the alarm fires Volkov shouts standoff_3 and runs; VO_094 plays when he exits.
